Name: Azmaveth, Son of Jehoadah
Summary: Son of Jehoadah, named among the sons of Jehoadah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:36; 1 Chronicles 9:42: Son of Jehoadah, named among the sons of Jehoadah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Azmaveth stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
